fullContent:
Nirgundi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Galagandadi Chikitsa 44/77. Sarngadhara Samhita Madhyama Khanda 9/198 
 Introduction 
 Nirgundi Thailam is an herbal and Ayurvedic oil that is beneficial in treating cysts and abscesses. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Nirgundi ( Vitex negundo ) 
 Langali ( Gloriosa superba ) 
 Taila ( Sesamum indicum ) Oil 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are added to oil and oil is prepared by oil paak method. 
 How to Use? 
 Nirgundi Thailam can be applied externally as well and this medicine must be used with doctor’s advice only. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Nirgundi Taila is beneficial Ayurvedic treatment for cysts, abscesses. 
 It is even good in curing non-healing wounds. 
 It also has anti-inflammatory effect. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 Avoid this oil in children and pregnant women. 
 This must be used under strict medical directions only. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
